goal: Eine kleine Struktur-Capability implementieren: vorhandene Browser-Draft-Elemente duplizieren, mit neuer monotoner Draft-ID und bei Choice-Feldern neuen monotonen Option-IDs inklusive korrekt umgebundener defaultSelection. Keine Persistenz.

guide_delta.summary: Ein platziertes Element kann browserlokal dupliziert werden. Die Kopie erhält eine neue Draft-ID; Choice-Optionen erhalten ebenfalls neue IDs, damit keine Identität wiederverwendet wird.

direct_dependencies: I132 defaultSelection is browser-local and green
nextDraftId and nextDraftOptionId remain monotone browser-local allocators
I129 persistence boundary remains plan-only and closed
tests_required: Step 1: compile browser_shell.py, test_browser_shell.py and test_i133_duplicate.py
Step 1: duplicated element must receive a new monotone draft ID
Step 1: duplicated choice options must receive new monotone option IDs
Step 1: duplicated defaultSelection must map to the duplicate option IDs
Step 2 after green: add real Chromium evidence at 100/150/200 percent for duplicate control, identity separation, preview and focus
Step 2: close only the existing structure TODO and synchronize README/TODO progress to 21 of 132
tests_explicitly_not_run: database/repository tests because no persistence path changes
Control Plane tests because governance is unchanged
full product suite because the change is browser-local and targeted
risks: reusing the source draft ID would break element identity
reusing option IDs would couple two independent choice fields
defaultSelection must be rebound to cloned option IDs rather than copied verbatim
duplicate control must remain keyboard/focus safe at narrow widths
non_changes: no JSON schema or SQLite changes
no HTTP write route or browser storage
expected_side_effects: a draft element can be duplicated in browser memory
the duplicate preserves user-visible properties while receiving independent draft and option identities
defaultSelection is rebound to cloned choice-option IDs
real Chromium evidence covers duplicate identity separation, preview, focus and overflow at 100/150/200 percent
